column1: # Shared cases of the allocation rule: check_builds.py next_step and BuildPlan.java must both reach expect. Skill ids are arbitrary numbers, unrelated to the game.
# steps = lvl:skill:to[:s] (s = save)，逗号分隔 | comma separated; base / reasons = skill=n，逗号分隔，空 = - | empty = -
# reasons: 0 能学 | learnable, 2 等级 | level, 3 前置 | prerequisite, 5 卡在上限 | cap-locked, 6 已满 | maxed, 7 数据错 | data error
# expect = 状态 下标 [等级]（等级 0 不写） | state index [level] (a level of 0 is left out)
# table（可选）= 往后看的技能表 skill:req:max[:pre/pre]，逗号分隔；没有这一列 = 不往后看 | table (optional) = the skill table for the look ahead, skill:req:max[:pre/pre], comma separated; no column = no look ahead
